content: Paul Appeals to the Emperor
Noqw Festus tutskwamakiway ep pítuhqe, ahpiy pāyis talq Caesareat aṅqw Jerusalem aqw’a.
Noqw pahsat pu God awwat mohpeq móṅwi‐niqw, pu Jew‐sinmuy amuṅaqw pavansinom put aw Paul lavayta.
Nihqe as pam put ehpewi pumuy amuṅem hihta hinhtiniqat aw nānawaknaqe pam put wáṅwayhq, Jerusalem aqwniqat aw ö’qalya, puma haqam put moqmaye’ nīnayaniqey tunatyawk̇ahk̇aṅwo.
Noqw Festus lavayhtiqe, pay Paul Caesareat epeq qátuniqat paṅqawu, pay pam soon pas hisat nāp paṅsoqniqey paṅqawu.
Oviy amuṅaqw haqawat ö’qalt inumumyani, kita. Nen kurs it tāqat ep himu qalomáhintaniqw paṅqaqwani.
Noqw pam pumuy amumum pakwút‐sikis haqam talöṅnat, Caesareat aqw’a; nihqe qavoṅvaqw, pam haqam hin yukiltiṅwuqat ep qatuptuqe, Paul wik‐wisniqat paṅqawu.
Noqw pam pituqw, Jew‐sinom Jerusalem aṅqw ö́kihqam put aqlaq hoṅk̇ahk̇aṅw, hīhihta nuhtsel’e’wakw nihtiwhtaqat Paul ehpewi yuaatota; nit pay put pas suyan pantaqat kurs hin paṅqaqwani.
Noqw pam nēṅem lavayhtiqe paṅqawu: Nu qa haqam Jew‐sinmuy tutavoyamuy ehpewi hinhti, piw God kīyat ehpewii, pu Caesar ehpewii.
Noqw tuwat pay Festus Jew‐sinmuy unaṅwve hinhtiniqey nāwaknaqe, Paul aw paṅqawu: Ya um qa Jerusalem aqwnen, pepeq inutpip īit yantaqat ep hin aw pohtiwniqey nāwakna?
Pahsat pu Paul paṅqawu: Nu Caesar pavasiwhkiyat ep wunu, pi nu pep hin yukuniwni; pi nu qa haqam hihta ep Jew‐sinmuy amumi qalomáhinhtiqw um suyan navoti’ta.

Pi as nu haqam hihta ep hinhte’, sen mokiwuy hihk̇ay’taqat hinhte’ soon nu moknik rohomnumni; nīk̇aṅw kurs pay ima nuy hīhihta qalomátsotsk̇anayaqw pam qa himuwa pas antsaniqw, soon hak nuy pumuy amumi nóani. Nu Caesar aw taqa’naṅwti.
Pahsat pu Festus wuwan’ayamuy amumum hin hintaniqat yuaaykuqe put aw lavayhtiqe paṅqawu: Noqw um Caesar aw taqa’naṅwti? Pay um soon Caesar qa aqwni.
Paul before Agrippa and Bernice
Noqw ahpiy hihsakishaqam talq, Moṅwi Agrippa Bernice amum Festus aw hahlayhtiniqe Caesareat ep pitu.
Pu ōviy Festus Agrippat aw Paul lalvayhqe paṅqawu: Felix ahpiynihqe, hakiy tāqat sómiwtaqat mātavi.
Noqw ura nu Jerusalem épeqniqw, God awwat mohpeq momṅwit Jew‐sinmuy wukw’aymuyatuy amumum nuy put hin āawnayaqe, eṅem qalomáyukiltiniqat nānawakna.

Noqw nu pumuy amumi lavayhtiqe paṅqawu: Kurs uma hihta ep put qalomátsok̇anayaqw, pay pam umuhpewinen nēṅem hin lavayhtiniqat put eṅem qenitiwni. Noqw kurs pam pas antsa hihta mokiwuy hihk̇ay’taqat hinhte’, pep pu’ pam mokiwuy aw noiwni. Pu pam nāto qa nēṅem hin lavayhtiqw, kurs nu hin put tūvani. Pan hapi Rome aṅqw sinmuy tuwiamu.
Noqw ōviy pumuy ökiqw, nu qa sȫwunit, qavoṅvaqw haqam hin yukiltiṅwuqat ep qatuptuqe, put tāqat wik‐wisniqat paṅqawu.
Noqw ima put hihta qalomátsok̇anayaqam hoṅvaqe, qa hin iwuwniy an put hihta tsok̇anaya.
Pay tuwat soq kurs pas nāp tuptsiwniy ep put amum nenṅem hinyuṅwa, pu hakiy Jesus mokqat ep’e. Noqw pay Paul put pay suyan qátuhqat paṅqawlawhqat ep’e.
Noqw nu pūvut pantaqat ep wiwsiqe, sen pam Jerusalem aqwnen pepeq īit hihta ep aw pohtiwniqat put tūvinta.
Noqw pay ason pas Moṅwi Augustus Paul aw hihta ep hin navotniqat pam paṅqawhq, ōviy nu ason hisat put Caesar aqw táviniqat aw pahsavo pay hāk put pani’yuṅwniqat nu paṅqawu.
Noqw Agrippa Festus aw paṅqawu: Is as tuwat aw tūqayta. Um qāvo aw tūqaytani, pam kita.

Qavoṅvaqw Agrippa Bernice amum pas pavan k̇āhink̇aṅw, haqam hihta yuaatotaṅwuqat aw paki, aṅ pas pavan solāwmomṅwituy‐nik̇aṅw pu kitsókive pas pavansinmuy tsamk̇aṅwo; pu ōviy Festus paṅqawhq, Paul wikvaya.

Noqw Festus paṅqawu: Moṅwi Agrippa, pu uma sohsoyam tahtaqt itamumyaqamu, uma it tāqat aw tāyuṅqw, it hapi ep sohsoyam Jew‐sinom inumi ökiwta, Jerusalem epeq’a, pu yep’e; nihqe pay pāpu pas pam qa qátuniqat paṅqaqwa.
Noqw nu navotq, kurs pay pam qa haqam hihta mokiwuy hihk̇ay’taqat hinhti. Pu piw pam pas nāp Augustus aw taqa’naṅwtiqw, ōviy nu put aqw táviniqey pan yuku.
Noqw pas nu imoṅwiy aqw kurs hin pas suyan hihta put pēnani; nihqe ōviy nu paniqw it umutpipo wikva, tis pi ōviy pas utpipoo, Moṅwi Agrippa; ason put aw pohtiwhq, pep pu’ pay k̇a nu sen hin pēnani.
Ispi hak hakiy sivilawhqat paṅsoq távinik̇aṅw, hihta ep qaantaqat qa paṅqawniqw, pam pay nuyniqw qa wuwni’hinta.
